checks.name: Every sampled accent has a measured foreground of at least 4.5
Custom backgrounds, table hover/active surfaces, helpers, focus and borders remain readable in both appearances
Every variant retains native behavior and loading/disabled labels across all four languages
No page renders a native button, invents a shared-button paint contract or restores the important danger-link override
Staff catalogue hydrates normally while token customer routes remain public

limitations: Source and renderer checks are complemented by actual-browser computed-style and screenshot audits; physical OS/PWA settings still need device acceptance.
